chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib and Yaqoub Al Sarraj, altogether, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:

Amir Al-Momineen (peace be upon him) said: 'O people! The transgressor will be guiding his companions to the Fire, and that the first one who transgressed against Allah was Anaaq, daughter of Adam. Thus, the first one whom Allah killed was Anaaq; and when sitting she would occupy one acre. And she had twenty fingers, in every finger there being two nails similar to a scythe. So Allah made a lion like the elephant, and a wolf like the camel, and an eagle like the mule to kill her. So they killed her, and Allah has killed the tyrants upon the best of their states, and (when they were) as safe as they could have been.'
ai.seo_question: Who was the first person to transgress against Allah according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi links the cosmic principle of al-baghy (transgression/extravagance) to the first human homicide, identifying Cain (Qabil) as the first to transgress against God by killing Abel. It illustrates the theological concept that divine punishment often strikes tyrants at the peak of their security, a theme reinforced by the detailed description of Anaaq’s unique physical traits and her death by God-sent beasts.

en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib and Yaqoub Al Sarraj, altogether, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘O you people! The transgressor will be guiding his companions to the Fire, and that the first one who trasngressed against Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> was Anaaq daughter of Adam<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup>. Thus, the first one whom Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Killed was Anaaq; and when sitting she would occupy one acre. and she had twenty fingers for her, in every finger there being two nails similar to a scythe. So Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Made a lion like (the size of the elephant, and a wolf like (the size of a) camel, and an eagle like (the size of the) mule to kill her. So they killed her, and Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> has Killed the tyrants upon the best of their states, and (when they were) as safe as they could have been’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali has narrated from his father from ibn Mahbub from ibn Ri’ab and Ya’qub ibn al-Sarraj all from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:

“Amir al-Mu’minin, Ali ibn abu Talib (a.s.) has said, ‘O people, tyrannical transgression leads its associates to the fire. The first person who committed it against Allah was ‘Unaq, daughter of Adam, the first one that Allah killed was ‘Unaq who, when sitting occupied one acre. She had twenty fingers each of which had two fingernails like two sickles. Allah made a lion of the size of an elephant, a wolf of the size of a camel and a vulture of the size of a donkey to kill her. Allah has eliminated the transgressing tyrants in their most ideal and peaceful conditions.’”
